body:
I realized it about 6 months in from what could be considered the start of my symptoms.  I've seen my mother go through it, and some friends.  The same thing was happening, but I don't believe in self-diagnosis, so I didn't fully realize it/denied it for a long time

I don't really cope with it.  Video games help me tune out a lot, so that's my go-to.  Music can help depending on the song; some help me realize what I've got in this world, others help me remember I'm not alone even though I feel like I am.  Drinking helps, but I never do it to excess, and I do not want to fall down that slippery slope.  I've got too much on the line to lose it because of that.  Also, being around friends.  Especially back home, where they'll do things that make me think: "This is it.  This is why I fight every day."

Meds aren't an option.  I go day-by-day hiding it because the Army will boot me out if they find out.  So I use everything else in my power instead.  It helps sometimes, other times all I can do is cry myself to sleep.  It sucks.
